messages:
marta: Heads up team — Peregrine Health case interview booked Tue 10am PT. Aim: 3 shareable quotes + one ~12s audio clip for socials.
jack: I can record (Zoom local + Otter backup). Whos doing notes/transcript?
nina: Ill run the guide and pull quotes live. Ill tag sensitive lines.
liam: Peregrine requires PR/legal sign-off on quotes. Route candidate lines to me after the call. 24h turnaround if possible.
rachel: I can provide a short benchmark stat (if product ops confirms) by Mon EOD.
samoe: If we get the stat, Ill wire the Pardot tag and SDR routing. Tag will be campaign=peregrine_2026_cs, queue=mid-market-health.
marta: Plan: jack records, nina uploads transcript to docs, nina tags 5 candidate lines (safe/needs-edit/sensitive), then liam reviews. Target publish Fri 2026-03-19 AM pending legal.
jack: Recording checklist posted in the assets doc. Will share link after the call.
nina: Candidate quotes (examples):
- "Redwood reduced our inference latency significantly in production." (edited per legal)
- "We saw immediate cost savings after switching to dedicated pools." (safe)
- "The rollout was seamless and the team was responsive." (safe)
liam: I reviewed — add Q4 2025 benchmark parenthetical to any stat claims and include original transcript lines when sending to legal.
marta: Nina to draft short blog + tweet copy. Sam to confirm Pardot tag. Rachel to drop stat. Legal to clear quotes by Thu EOD so we can publish Fri. Embargo note: Do not publish before Fri 2026-03-19 09:00 PT.
samoe: Pardot tag confirmed.
jack: Recording uploaded: https://drive.redwood/recs/peregrine-2026-03-10.mp3. I'll push 12s clip to design today.
nina: Blog draft in docs for comments. I flagged two lines as sensitive.
liam: Received assets. Will prioritize legal review and return edits by Thu EOD.
marta: Thanks all — final checklist: legal OK, design assets in Figma, Pardot tagging, blog/tweet copy ready. If all green we go live Fri morning. :rocket:
